summary.text: Brian Lambert, a Libertarian Party nominee and retired U.S. Navy veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 14th Congressional District to Kathy Castor.
He served 20 years in the Navy and completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Lambert graduated from Cairo High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Ashford University in 2018.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1998 to 2018. In his Ballotpedia survey he says his roles included Aircraft Mechanic, Flight Engineer, and Intelligence Specialist.
The Libertarian primary for the seat was canceled.
He received 2.9% of the vote to Kathy Castor's 51.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
